name: O successores (jazz reharm)
comment: Hildegard of Bingen, O successores (antiphon for confessors), jazz reharmonization. Built 2026-11-02 (status: derived, not auditioned). Clock: professorimprov's notation video (youtube XXLpwOrsqto). Method (Nathan): cluster the chant's notes with the drone, take a Boyd chord containing the whole cluster, use Boyd's voicing. Chant from pitch tracking of the video, checked against Beverly Lomer's transcription (ISHBS 2017: D mode, range A3-F5, Bb where signed). Drone tracked from the audio: D throughout, with A added at ~38-46, 56-66, 100-104, 112-118 s (Basic Pitch still hears D under the A spans). Rules: clusters of at most 3 chant pitch classes (4 when absorbing a short fragment), at most 8 s, split at breaths and drone changes; chord = richest Boyd chord (up to 6 notes) holding the cluster + drone, drone in the bass when possible, no added note a half step from a sung note or the drone, not the same chord twice in a row; scale = the Pressing scale holding the chord with the most of the chant's mode.
